summary: STIFTELSEN VIGELAND HOVEDGÅRD (org. no. 975 878 295) is a foundation (STI) based in Vennesla, in the Brønnøysund registers since 1995-11-15. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 68.200 (Utleie av egen eller leid fast eiendom); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 464 000 and net income was -NOK 65 240. Board chair: Ole Harald Mykland; auditor: REVISJON SØR AS.
